integrity: The theorem is proved by explicit complete graph-isomorphism and finite-state enumeration with fully provided source and data. No sampled experiment is treated as an infinite theorem; no external certification or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is exhaustive only at the fixed natural order twelve; nothing is asserted for larger cubic bipartite graphs.
Some relevant historic graph-specific documents are not fully indexed or accessible; historical priority is not guaranteed.
There is no external independent mathematical audit; two exact implementation approaches are same-model checks.
title: Exact majority attraction spectra of all five cubic bipartite graphs on twelve vertices
